entities.name: Service-level-AA container
entities.description: An information element included by the SMF when the service-level authentication and authorization procedure is completed successfully by the external DN.

entities.name: Service-level authentication and authorization procedure
entities.description: A procedure performed by the external DN for service-level authentication and authorization.

entities.name: Service-level AA procedure completed successfully
entities.description: Condition indicating the service-level authentication and authorization procedure has been completed successfully by the external DN.

entities.name: SMF
entities.description: Session Management Function that includes the Service-level-AA container IE.

entities.name: External DN
entities.description: External Data Network that performs the service-level authentication and authorization procedure.

relations.description: SMF includes the Service-level-AA container IE when the service-level AA procedure is successfully completed.
Inclusion of the Service-level-AA container IE is conditional on successful completion of the service-level AA procedure.
Successful completion of the service-level AA procedure establishes the condition for including the Service-level-AA container IE.
The external DN performs the service-level authentication and authorization procedure.
